acceptance_criteria.evidence_ref: cargo test --locked vibehub::workflow => 12 passed; parses_legacy_phases_only_workflow and parses_new_capabilities_and_gates_workflow cover both formats.

acceptance_criteria.description: gates 支持 all / any / not 组合。
acceptance_criteria.evidence_ref: cargo test --locked vibehub::workflow => 12 passed; validates_nested_all_any_not_gates covers nested all/any/not.

notes.summary: M2a adds a dedicated workflow parser/validator module and reuses it from phase resolution so legacy phase behavior stays on the same parsing path.
The default workflow now declares capabilities and gates while preserving phases and phase_order for existing commands.
Gate evaluation is intentionally not implemented in M2a; M2b should consume the parsed gate expressions and event stream.

next_session_should: Start M2b: implement the gate evaluator against events.jsonl plus workflow.yaml.
Add vibehub-claim skill/command behavior while keeping vibehub-continue as an alias.
Use docs/vibehub-sync-condition-algorithm.md as the algorithm input and preserve M2a parser compatibility tests.
